lesson.grammar_point: present continuous (I am checking, it is loading: affirmative, negative and questions)

listenings.text: Okay, Diogo, I am connecting to your computer now. I can see your screen. Now I am opening the settings of the account. I am downloading the new version. It is installing, and it is a little slow. Don't worry, it is not a problem. Now I am restarting the program. Good news: the user is receiving emails again.

Hi Diogo, Ravi here, with an update on ticket six one nine. Right now our team is fixing the server. We are installing a new version of the VPN. The VPN is not working at the moment, so please tell your users to work from the office. I am writing the report now, and I am calling you again at five.

extra_audio.text: Karen is connecting to Diogo's computer. Diogo is sharing his screen. The page is loading. Karen is installing an update. The user is receiving messages again.
